outcome: peri-rectal colonization with drug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria (DR-GNB)
cohort: 200 hospitalized preterm neonates were randomly allocated to receive either a multi-strain probiotic or a placebo.
finding: The administration of a multi-strain probiotic was effective in reducing early (by day 7) and late (by day 14) peri-rectal colonization with drug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria in preterm neonates.
